NMAS.description: Nodal Mass (NMAS). Assigns lumped translational and rotational masses at a node; the key equals the target node number (a node with that number must already exist).

mX.description: Translational lumped mass in the GCS X-direction.

mY.description: Translational lumped mass in the GCS Y-direction.

mZ.description: Translational lumped mass in the GCS Z-direction.

rmX.description: Rotational mass moment of inertia about the GCS X-axis.

rmY.description: Rotational mass moment of inertia about the GCS Y-axis.

rmZ.description: Rotational mass moment of inertia about the GCS Z-axis.
